policy.rule: Primary provider evidence may add Independent Living and service/lifestyle modalities to an existing Nevada licensed facility identity, but never changes the regulatory license type or confirms Memory Care without HCQC evidence.
policy.memory_care_rule: Provider marketing that mentions memory care is not regulatory Memory Care confirmation. HCQC/ALiS endorsement evidence remains authoritative.

records.evidence_summary: Acacia Springs' primary site explicitly offers Independent Living and Assisted Living in Las Vegas; its Independent Living page verifies apartment residences, housekeeping/maintenance, dining, social programming and transportation. Regulatory Assisted Living identity remains the existing HCQC RFG license.

Avamere at Cheyenne's primary site explicitly lists Independent Living, Assisted Living and Respite Care and publishes separate Independent Living and Assisted Living apartment pricing. Regulatory Assisted Living identity remains the existing HCQC RFG license.
